Authenticating With API Keys

Section 1. Generate a key on the dashboard. Store it in environment variables; never commit it to source control.

Section 2. Documents from the public API are returned as JSON. The 200 response indicates success; 401 indicates a missing key.

Section 3. Rate limits are applied per token. Check the response headers for X-RateLimit-Remaining before issuing the next call.
